name: Barbarian audit: Bellowing Voice spell modifier reaches its target spells (#2048)
contract: Audit report #2048 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

561322 op 8 percent +20 reaches 300857 (mask selects 11 Barbarian spell(s))
